presentation.description:
Paste an Eorzea Collection link and wear the outfit. Every slot is shown before anything is applied: what matched, what was a guess, and what could not be found. Requires Glamourer, which does the actual dressing.

Save outfits to a local library that keeps its gear, so wearing one again needs no network call. Open /glink to import, /glink library to browse.
presentation.summary: Wear any glamour from Eorzea Collection.

variant.author: XivHub
variant.description: Requires Glamourer. Paste an Eorzea Collection glamour URL or id and GlamourLink reads its gear list from Eorzea Collection's undocumented JSON endpoint, resolves it against the game's own item and dye sheets, and applies the result to your character through Glamourer's IPC. Unmatched items are reported rather than guessed silently, and every fuzzy-matched item is labelled as a guess. Optionally saves the result as a named Glamourer design. Saved outfits keep their resolved gear, so applying one needs no call to Eorzea Collection; open /glink library to browse them. Open /glink in game to import.
